newsitem.title: UK: Atlantic rates may be turning in owners favour.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic rates may be turning in owners favour.

text.p: Despite a fall of six points on Wednesday reducing the BFI to 1,428 points brokers believed that the Atlantic was starting to move in owners' favour in the dry cargo freight market.
A critical phase lies ahead with the Thanksgiving holiday regarded as an annual turning point in the shipping business.

It was said that a good volume of grain and fertilizer orders were outstanding from USGulf for December shipment and, significantly, that there were grain charterers now willing to concede $24.00 basis no combination for tonnage loading in the first half of the month.
The last reported fixture in this trade was Ever Blessing at $23.40 with combination for early Dec.

The caper market was reckoned to be relatively busy with no decisive trend, although one broker believed that rates 'could easily firm up'. Handy-size levels were static or easier in most areas, with the possible exception of the us gulf.

GRAIN - Rumours flew around the market this morning suggesting that a Panamax was fixed with lights USGulf to Ccontinent for as little as $12.75, and that 54,000 heavy grain USGulf/Japan had been fixed by Goldbeam for Dec 5/15 at $24.00 no combo.

Neither could be confirmed. Similarly Nephele was rumoured fixed for 54,000 heavy grain Nopac/Japan at $15.00, but it was unclear whether or not this was a combination rate, and confirmation was unobtainable.

Timecharter business in the grain trades on the other hand was confirmed - Halla fixed the 1981-built Anangel Argonaut 65,668 dwt delivery USGulf Dec 11/19 trip Japan at $12,500 daily plus $250,000 bonus.
Katrina booked the 1978-built Petropolis 63,970 dwt with the same dates and delivery on private terms, estimated to be at about $12,000/12,200 daily plus $200,000 bonus.

Marifran were rumoured to have fixed Maratha Mission 75,000 dwt delivery prompt Ghent for 2 laden legs Atlantic Trading, and there were reports of Australian Wheat Board activity with Panamaxes, but further details were lacking.

Fresh orders for Panamaxes included Sinochart delivery US Gulf Dec 16/28 trip China with grain or fertilizers, Bluedeck 50-60,000 dwt delivery SW Pass Dec 20/30 trip E.Mediterranean, D'Amato 55,000 heavy grain USGulf/Spanish Med for Dec 25/Jan 4, and Marti 52-54,000 heavy grain USGulf/Japan for Jan 1/10.

In addition to Continental's enquiry Tuesday for prompt tonnage for 40/47,000 grains 51 ft draft USGulf/Jjeddah or Aaqaba, these charterers quoted today 5,000 heavy grain Mississippi/Salaverry and Callao for Dec 10/20 and 15/25,000 meals 55 ft prompt USGulf/Holland, Belgium or Poland. Andre have a new enquiry for 25,000 wheat Plate/Algeria for Dec 10/25, Glencore 20,000 wheat Plate/UMM Qasr prompt, and Soufflet 15,000 bagged barley Antwerp/Libya for Dec 10/15.

MINERALS - Few Caper fixtures were available despite brokers reporting busier conditions. Leon 145,015 dwt was understood to be fixed on subjects by Cheer Glory delivery Beilufor a Saldanha bay ironore round at about $8,000 daily.

COAL - Timecharters were mixed and brokers considered Mosk's fixting of Maritsa 73,095 dwt delivery prompt Japan for an E.Australian round at $12,150 daily to be weaker. Sanko booked Yick Kam 66,926 dwt delivery Kosichang mid Dec for trip via Indonesia with coal to Carboneras in the high $7,000's daily, and Samsun fixed 1975-built Atlantica 63,990 dwt on subjects delivery Nhava Sheva trip via S.Africa/Morocco $6,000 daily.

BHP were reckoned to have taken Mui Kim for 55,000 coal E. Australia/Continent for Dec 15/25 at $12.90, and Cetragpa were linked with Sea Radiance for 60,000 Roberts Bank/Lisbon for Dec 5/15 at $13.50.

Coe and Clerici were reported to have fixed Mariner C 65,085 dwt for a W.Africa round at $10,500 daily, and Frapaco were rumoured to have covered a Panamax fertilizer cargo from Tampa to china on private terms.
HANDY-SIZES - Olympic Mentor 29,000 dwt was booked Byan Ocean delivery US Gulf Dec 6/12 trip far East at a solid $10,850 daily plus $60,000 bonus.

Ld-Seals fixed a couple of craned bulkers from the continent to the far East on private terms. Brokers reckoned conditions were easier for geared bulkers in the East - for example, HMM are said to have taken Agia Eirini 37,000 dwt delivery Singapore Nov/Dec trip Boston-Galveston range at only $4,700 daily for the first 80 days and $7,000 daily for the balance. Fiora Topic 37,000 dwt was fixed by Hanjin in the Pacific for short period on private terms.
